STU-CODE-01.reference_answer:
def is_even(n: int) -> bool:
    return n % 2 == 0
STU-CODE-01.check_code:
assert is_even(4) is True
assert is_even(7) is False
assert is_even(0) is True

STU-CODE-02.reference_answer:
def reverse_string(s: str) -> str:
    return s[::-1]

STU-CODE-03.reference_answer:
def sum_of_squares(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    return sum(x * x for x in nums)

STU-CODE-04.reference_answer:
def count_vowels(text: str) -> int:
    return sum(1 for c in text.lower() if c in 'aeiou')

STU-CODE-05.reference_answer:
def find_max(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    return max(nums)

STU-CODE-06.check_code:

assert is_palindrome('race a car') is False

STU-CODE-08.reference_answer:
def flatten_list(nested: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
    return [item for sub in nested for item in sub]

STU-STUDY-01.reference_answer: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants synthesize glucose from carbon dioxide and water using sunlight absorbed by chlorophyll. Oxygen is released as a byproduct during this reaction.

STU-STUDY-02.reference_answer: Newton's First Law states that an object remains at rest or in uniform motion unless acted upon by an external unbalanced force. This tendency to resist change in motion is called inertia, such as when passengers lurch forward when a bus brakes suddenly.

STU-STUDY-03.reference_answer: Kinetic energy is the energy possessed by an object due to its motion, like a moving car. Potential energy is stored energy due to an object's position or state, such as water stored behind a dam.

STU-STUDY-04.reference_answer: The water cycle describes continuous water movement on Earth. Water heats and undergoes evaporation into vapor, cools to form clouds via condensation, and falls back to Earth as precipitation.

STU-STUDY-05.reference_answer: Plant cells possess a rigid cellulose cell wall and chloroplasts for photosynthesis, whereas animal cells lack both cell walls and chloroplasts and have only a flexible cell membrane.

STU-STUDY-06.reference_answer: Ohm's Law states that current flowing through a conductor between two points is directly proportional to voltage and inversely proportional to resistance: V = I * R.

STU-STUDY-07.reference_answer: Hemoglobin is an iron-rich protein in red blood cells that binds reversibly to oxygen in the lungs to form oxyhemoglobin, transporting oxygen to tissues throughout the body.

STU-STUDY-08.reference_answer: Renewable energy comes from inexhaustible natural sources like solar and wind power. Non-renewable energy comes from finite sources that deplete over time, such as coal and petroleum.

STU-STUDY-09.reference_answer: Enzymes are protein catalysts that speed up chemical reactions by lowering the activation energy required. Substrate molecules bind specifically to the enzyme's active site forming an enzyme-substrate complex.

STU-STUDY-10.reference_answer: The greenhouse effect is the trapping of heat in Earth's atmosphere by gases such as carbon dioxide and methane, preventing thermal radiation from escaping into space and causing global warming.

STU-HIN-01.reference_answer: प्रकाश संश्लेषण वह प्रक्रिया है जिसके द्वारा हरे पौधे सूर्य के प्रकाश और क्लोरोफिल की सहायता से अपना भोजन बनाते हैं। इस प्रक्रिया में पौधे कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड लेते हैं और ऑक्सीजन छोड़ते हैं।

STU-HIN-02.reference_answer: जल संरक्षण के लिए वर्षा जल संचयन करना चाहिए और दैनिक कार्यों में पानी का व्यर्थ बहाव रोकना चाहिए।

STU-HIN-03.reference_answer: सौर मंडल का सबसे बड़ा ग्रह बृहस्पति है। यह एक गैसीय दानव है और इसमें विशाल लाल धब्बा तूफान मौजूद है।

STU-HIN-04.reference_answer: संतुलित आहार वह आहार है जिसमें शरीर की वृद्धि और स्वास्थ्य के लिए सभी आवश्यक पोषक तत्व उचित मात्रा में हों, जैसे प्रोटीन और कार्बोहाइड्रेट।

STU-HIN-05.reference_answer: पर्यावरण प्रदूषण रोकने के लिए वृक्षारोपण बढ़ाना चाहिए, प्लास्टिक का उपयोग बंद करना चाहिए और सार्वजनिक वाहनों का अधिक उपयोग करना चाहिए।

STU-HIN-06.reference_answer: हार्डवेयर कंप्यूटर के भौतिक भाग होते हैं जिन्हें हम छू सकते हैं जैसे कीबोर्ड और मॉनिटर। सॉफ्टवेयर वे प्रोग्राम और निर्देश होते हैं जो कंप्यूटर को कार्य करने का निर्देश देते हैं।

STU-HIN-07.reference_answer: भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना भारत को एक संप्रभु, समाजवादी, धर्मनिरपेक्ष, लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य घोषित करती है और सभी नागरिकों के लिए सामाजिक, आर्थिक व राजनीतिक न्याय, स्वतंत्रता, समानता और बंधुता सुनिश्चित करती है।

STU-HIN-08.reference_answer: ओजोन परत समताप मंडल में स्थित है और यह सूर्य से आने वाली हानिकारक पराबैंगनी किरणों को अवशोषित करके पृथ्वी पर जीवन की रक्षा करती है।

STU-SUM-01.reference_answer: The Udayagiri High-Altitude Solar and Astronomical Research Facility was founded in 1974 by Dr. Anandamurthy Kulkarni and Professor Sneha Deshmukh. It is situated on the Vindhyachal plateau at latitude 23.4128 N, longitude 77.7214 E, at an elevation of 742 meters above sea level. Its three primary historical instruments were the Surya-70 Solar Spectrograph, the Vindhya-120 Cassegrain Reflector (1.2m), and the Rohini Wide-Field Schmidt Camera. In 2003, the facility installed a 150 kW solar photovoltaic microgrid to achieve energy independence and prevent detector interruptions.

- Mechanism: Summer heating creates a low-pressure area drawing moist Southwest Monsoon winds from the Indian Ocean between June and September.
- Agriculture: Supplies over 70% of annual rainfall essential for Kharif crops like rice, pulses, and sugarcane.
- Distribution: Rainfall is uneven, with Western Ghats and Northeast receiving over 2,500 mm while the Thar desert remains arid.
